skill_name: Add an extra paragraph to the given passage to make it more convincing.
workflow: Many of the disparities between high income and low income students can be attributed to unequal access to resources. For example, low-income students are less likely to have access to enrichment opportunities such as tutoring, private music or language lessons, or extracurricular activities. They also tend to have fewer books at home, family members who are less able to help with homework, and parents who have less time and money to devote to their children’s education.
